exposure: oral misoprostol solution for induction of labour
cohort: 200 pregnant women undergoing induction of labour after 36 weeks of pregnancy at Government Medical College, Aurangabad
finding: Oral misoprostol solution administration was successful in achieving vaginal delivery within 24 hours in 80.5% of patients, with a cesarean section rate of 19.5%.
mod_finding: Oral misoprostol was successful in achieving vaginal delivery in 80.5% of patients, with a lower cesarean section rate of 19.5%.
